'''Eos Morne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="ClubScene" /> participant in the party scene of<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]] in<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Morne visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Episode II" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> The partier stood near the club's entrance with the fellow Human<ref name="Episode II" /> [[Kell Borean]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] entered searching for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Episode II" /> 

Morne later moved to the club's bar, where they talked with another Human up until Kenobi sliced off Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] when she attempted to ambush the Jedi. Skywalker told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and the Jedi, with Wesell, left.<ref name="Episode II" /> The partygoer had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin, brown eyes, and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] worn in an updo.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> When they visited the Outlander Club, Morne wore a white [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] with heeled light yellow [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eos Morne appeared the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], during the Outlander Club scenes<ref name="Episode II" /> shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The character was later revealed on [[August 29]], [[2000]]<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref> when the<ref name="On location" /> uncredited<ref name="Episode II" /> extra playing Morne, in costume, introduced "The AD Stare," the fifth episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/5.html|series=On Location|text=Part 5 - The AD Stare}}</ref> The character made her first appearance in an illustration in the [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook|storybook]] for the then upcoming film, authored by [[Jane Mason]] and [[Sarah Hines Stephens]].<ref name="Storybook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook]]''</ref> The storybook released on [[April 23]], [[2002]],<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> before the film's [[May 16]], 2002, release.<ref name="Year2">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

Morne was first identified in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" department of the [[Star Wars Insider 136|136th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, written by [[Leland Chee]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> and published on [[September 4]], [[2012]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">[[Star Wars Insider 135|''Star Wars Insider'' 135]]</ref>
